name: hero-01
title: Hero 01 - Marketing Hero With An Optional Live Figure
description: A hero with an optional eyebrow, headline, supporting line and one or two actions, which may sit centered over the container or split with a live figure beside it. All copy and the figure itself are passed in as props.
